$comment: One hook, two schemas. VS Code reads PascalCase event names with `command` and `timeout`; Copilot cloud agent and CLI read camelCase event names with `bash`/`powershell`/`command` and `timeoutSec`. Each host ignores the block it does not recognize, so the hook fires exactly once in either. The command invokes node directly on purpose: a bash or PowerShell wrapper is one more place for stdin to be lost, and stdin is the whole payload. Sources: https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/agent-customization/hooks and https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/reference/hooks-reference
